description: Returns APRS telemetry of one station for the last 1–48 hours: up to five analog channels (already converted with the station's own calibration equations) and 8 digital bits per sample, with channel names, units and bit labels when the station published them. Evenly thinned to at most 48 samples. Stations without published calibration return an empty result.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.

hours.description: How far back to read telemetry, in hours (1–48, default 24).

name: get_station_telemetry
title: Get station telemetry
